Name: Lynn's Bedroom (For Furniture Framework)
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
[b][center][size=5]Mod Basics﻿[/size][/center][/b][size=5][size=4]The quick and dirty of this is that this is a 1.6 version of my mod [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12403]Lynn's Bedroom for DGA[/url].[/size][/size]

The longer explanation is that DGA was never going to update to 1.6.  That left my pretty beds high and dry.  After I was able to update my chairs to 1.6 with FF, There was no way I was just going to sit back and try and use CP to add my beds... What if I could put slots or seats on them?!?!  And wouldn't you know it??? FF gave me those options!  So here we are!  After a bit of a wait, BEDS!

[b][center][size=5]What's new??[/size][/center][/b][size=3]So glad to tell you!  [/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]You no longer have to right click with items to put them in slots! [s]So we have the fact that you have to right click to place things in Slots.[/s][/size]
[*][size=2]Child bed added![/size]
[*][size=2]All beds have a Sit spot at the foot on either side of the bed[/size]
[*][size=2]All beds now have a rotation, with and without the foot board of the bed![/size]
[*][size=2]There are 2 slots to set items in the center of the single and child beds[/size]
[*][size=2]And 4 spots in the center of the double bed[/size]
[*][size=2]All beds have an additional 4 slots so they will be compatible with the new mod I'm making.[/size]
[*][size=2]The benches have a new slot also for this new mod.[/size]
[*][size=2]The vanity, desk, and nightstand have table spots on top of them.[/size]
[*][size=2]New wood and fabric colors![/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]Installing and Use[/center][/b][/size]Pretty standard TBH
1 Download this mod and FF
2 Unzip both into your mods folder
3 Profit 

[b]Returning users[/b], Hi! Did you grab the Chair one yet?  If you did I'm sure you know this...
If you are advancing a character with my stuff from 1.5.6 to 1.6, you're gonna wanna remove the old stuff before you do the jump because you will have weirdness going on. Then you're gonna have to delete my old mod and follow the above instructions. 
With the change from DGA to FF, there can't be a direct replacement.  So, sadly, out with the old versions in with the new.

[center][size=5][b]Compatibility [/b][/size][/center]
[b]Alternative Textures:[/b]  Furniture framework and AT don't work together so there is not now, nor will there be an AT version of this stuff.
[b]Other furniture mods:[/b] Shouldn't conflict, FF makes everything separate, so they don't over write each other at all.
[b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b]  This one's a bit weird.  So something in SVE mucks up how items set in slots saves that information.  So if you have SVE installed and you put something in a FF slot, when you save then leave the game and come back, whatever's in the slots will move to the first available slot.  Leroy is looking into this.  We hope it will be fixed soon.


[center][b][size=5]The Other Stuff[/size][/b][/center][b]
Translations[/b] are welcomed but I speak English and Bad English so I am not your girl for that.
[b]Support[/b] is now possible through my [url=http://Ko-fi.com/lynn_nexus]Kofi[/url]
And last but not least, I only put my mods here on Nexus so if you see my stuff elsewhere, please shun it.
